name: MSG91
label: MSG91 — MSG91 Flow / SMS API
description: MSG91 via the official MSG91 Flow / SMS API. Base https://control.msg91.com/api/v5. Docs: https://docs.msg91.com/reference/send-sms. India DLT / sender-ID rules. Use Flow API (v5), not retired query-string sendhttp.php. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data}. Attachments use type file (ref-id). Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One MSG91 operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"send-sms"}.

schema.label: template_id
schema.description: DLT/flow template id for send-sms POST /flow. Example: 6e0b3xxxx.

schema.label: recipients
schema.description: Recipients list [{mobiles, VAR1, …}] matching the template variables.

schema.label: short_url
schema.description: Whether to shorten URLs in the template. Example: 0 or 1.

schema.label: realTimeResponse
schema.description: 1 to wait for the provider response. Example: 1.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Auth key
configurationParameters.description: MSG91 authkey header. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
